body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The implementation hand-rolls a window 'message' event listener and a custom extractDraftContent parser instead of using the Contentstack Live Preview SDK's onLivePreview callback as prescribed in the root cause analysis. The SDK already handles message filtering, payload parsing, and content extraction. The custom extractDraftContent guesses at payload shape with chained optional access (payload?.data?.entry ?? payload?.entry ?? payload?.content ?? payload?.data?.content) which is fragile and not guaranteed to match the SDK's actual message format.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the hand-rolled message listener with the Contentstack Live Preview SDK's onLivePreview callback. Import the SDK and call its onLivePreview method inside the useEffect, passing a callback that receives the already-parsed draft content and calls setLiveContent. Remove extractDraftContent entirely.

issues.description: isLivePreviewEnabled uses window.self !== window.top as a fallback iframe detection, which is a generic iframe check — not specific to the Contentstack CMS editor. This could enable live preview message handling in any iframe context (e.g., social media embeds, third-party iframe wrappers), not just the CMS editor. The prescribed fix says to use the SDK's isLivePreviewEnabled or window.__CONTENTSTACK_LIVE_PREVIEW__ only.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the window.self !== window.top fallback. Only check window.__CONTENTSTACK_LIVE_PREVIEW__ (or the SDK's isLivePreviewEnabled if available). If the SDK provides an isLivePreviewEnabled function, use that instead of reimplementing detection.

issues.description: No unit tests exist for the modified ContentstackProvider. The review criteria require new features to have corresponding vitest unit tests in test/unit/ mirroring the src/ path. The live preview subscription logic, isLivePreviewEnabled detection, and content merging behavior are all untested.
issues.suggestedFix: Add test/unit/context/ContentstackContext.test.tsx with tests covering: (1) provider initializes with default content, (2) live preview events update content when isLivePreviewEnabled is true, (3) live preview events are ignored when not in CMS editor, (4) malformed message payloads don't crash the provider, (5) content prop changes sync to state.

issues.description: extractDraftContent uses untyped 'any' via Record<string, any> without an explanatory comment, violating TypeScript strict compliance. The function parameter is typed as 'unknown' (good) but internally casts to Record<string, any> and accesses properties with untyped any, losing type safety.
issues.suggestedFix: If keeping this function (though it should be replaced by SDK usage per blocker above), define an interface for the expected message payload shape and use type narrowing instead of Record<string, any>. Add explanatory comments for any remaining 'any' usage.

issues.description: The useEffect that syncs the content prop to state (setLiveContent(content)) can overwrite live preview draft updates. If the parent re-renders and passes the same or updated published content prop while a live preview session is active, this effect fires and replaces the draft content with published content, causing a flicker or revert. The prescribed fix says content should be mutable via live-preview events — this sync effect contradicts that.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the content-to-state sync useEffect. Initialize state with the content prop once (useState already does this). If the content prop can change at runtime (e.g., page navigation), handle that separately with a guard that only syncs when NOT in live preview mode, or use a key-based remount strategy.

issues.description: The useMemo wrapping liveContent is redundant: const value = useMemo(() => liveContent, [liveContent]) adds no memoization benefit since liveContent is already a state value that only changes when setLiveContent is called. The context provider will re-render consumers whenever liveContent changes regardless of this useMemo.
issues.suggestedFix: Pass liveContent directly to the Provider: <ContentstackContext.Provider value={liveContent}>. Remove the useMemo import if no longer used elsewhere.

issues.description: The global Window interface declares __CONTENTSTACK_LIVE_PREVIEW__ as 'unknown' type. Since it's only used in a boolean context (truthiness check), typing it as 'unknown' works but is imprecise. The Contentstack SDK likely types this as a specific object or boolean.
issues.suggestedFix: Type __CONTENTSTACK_LIVE_PREVIEW__ as the SDK's defined type (e.g., boolean or a specific config object interface) if the SDK provides types, or at minimum use 'boolean | object | undefined' to be more precise than 'unknown'.

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: No test coverage exists for the live_preview feature. I searched the test file for 'preview', 'PREVIEW', 'live_preview', 'setHost', and 'live' — zero matches were returned. The learned rules explicitly require tests for: (1) live_preview block present with preview_token when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN is set, (2) live_preview absent when token is unset, (3) setHost called with CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST when set. None of these exist. The test file only covers fetch timeout, missing env vars, and existing getEntry/getSingleEntry behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a describe('live_preview configuration') block with at minimum 3 it() blocks: (1) set CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN in process.env, require the module, assert options.live_preview exists with enable:true and the correct token; (2) leave CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN unset, assert options has no live_preview key; (3) set CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST, require the module, assert Stack.setHost was called with the preview host value.

issues.description: The diff uses 'management_token' as the key inside the live_preview config object, but the prescribed minimal fix explicitly specifies 'preview_token'. The Contentstack SDK live_preview configuration (per the documented API at the URL in the RCA) uses 'preview_token' as the key name. Using the wrong key name means the SDK will not receive the token and live preview will not function — the token will be silently ignored.
issues.suggestedFix: Change 'management_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN' to 'preview_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN' inside the live_preview config object to match the prescribed fix and the Contentstack SDK documentation.

issues.description: The diff adds 'host: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST' inside the live_preview config object AND a separate 'Stack.setHost(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST)' call. The prescribed fix does not include 'host' inside the live_preview object — it only specifies preview_token and enable. Additionally, the separate Stack.setHost(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST) call executes AFTER Stack.setHost(CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST), meaning when both env vars are set, the preview host overrides the API host for ALL requests (including normal delivery), not just preview requests. This would break non-preview content delivery in any environment where both hosts are configured.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the 'host: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST' line from inside the live_preview config object. For the setHost call, the Contentstack SDK's live_preview.host config (if the SDK supports it) should handle routing preview requests to the preview host without overriding the global Stack host. If the SDK does not support host inside live_preview, consider conditionally setting only one host based on whether preview mode is active, or verify that the SDK's setHost can be called per-request rather than globally.

issues.description: The file has '/* eslint-disable @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any */' at the top, and the renderOption uses untyped 'any' for node children and next callback parameters. While this is pre-existing, the diff does not address it. Per TypeScript strict compliance criteria, untyped 'any' should have explanatory comments.
issues.suggestedFix: Add typed interfaces for the renderOption span node and next callback, or add an inline comment explaining why 'any' is necessary here (Contentstack SDK does not export proper types for renderOption callbacks).

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: AC#1 & AC#2 NOT MET — The prescribed fix requires conditionally calling `.includeDraft()` on the query in `createContentTypeQuery` when a live_preview parameter is present. The diff only adds the Stack-level `live_preview` config to `options` (lines 62-69) but does NOT add `.includeDraft()` or any equivalent query-level draft-inclusion logic anywhere. Without this, the Stack may be configured for preview but all queries will still return only published content — draft content edited in the CMS will never appear on the rendered page.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a `live_preview` parameter to `ICreateQueryConfig` and `ICreateEntryConfig` interfaces, forward it through `createContentTypeQuery`/`createContentTypeEntryQuery`, and conditionally call `.includeDraft()` on the query when `live_preview` is present. Alternatively, if the Contentstack SDK's `live_preview` Stack config alone is sufficient for draft content retrieval (without per-query `.includeDraft()`), verify this with the SDK docs and add a comment explaining why no query-level call is needed.

issues.description: AC#1 & AC#2 NOT MET — No `live_preview` field exists in `ICommonContentstackConfig`, `ICreateQueryConfig`, `ICreateEntryConfig`, or any of the public function parameter interfaces (`IContentstackGetEntry`, `IContentstackGetSingleEntry`, `IContentstackGetSingletonEntry`). None of the public functions (`getEntry`, `getSingleEntry`, `getAllContentTypeEntries`, `findSingletonEntry`, `getSingletonEntry`) accept or forward a `live_preview` parameter. Even if `.includeDraft()` were added to `createContentTypeQuery`, there is no way for a caller (e.g., a page component receiving a preview URL query param) to pass preview context through to the query layer. Preview context is silently dropped at every call site.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `live_preview?: { enable: boolean; management_token: string; host: string }` (or a simpler boolean/string flag) to `ICommonContentstackConfig` so it propagates to all derived interfaces. Then update each public function to destructure and forward `live_preview` to `createContentTypeQuery`/`createContentTypeEntryQuery`.

issues.description: AC#4 NOT MET — No test coverage exists for the live_preview feature. A search for 'live_preview|preview|PREVIEW|includeDraft|setHost' in contentstack.spec.ts returned zero matches. Required test scenarios: (1) `live_preview` block present in `options` with `management_token` when `CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN` and `CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST` are set, (2) `live_preview` block absent when the token is unset, (3) if `.includeDraft()` is added, a test that calls a public function (e.g., `getEntry`) with a `live_preview` parameter and asserts the mock's `includeDraft` method was called.
issues.suggestedFix: Add test cases to `src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts` covering: (1) options includes `live_preview` when env vars are set, (2) options excludes `live_preview` when env vars are absent, (3) end-to-end forwarding of preview context through a public function to the query's `.includeDraft()` call. Add `includeDraft: jest.fn().mockReturnThis()` to the Stack mock.

issues.description: The `live_preview` config uses `management_token` as the key. The dependency_contract tool confirms `management_token` IS consumed by contentstack v3.17.2, while `preview_token` is absent. However, the prescribed fix specified `preview_token`. The implementer should verify that `management_token` is the correct key for the Live Preview feature (not just the Management API), as the SDK may distinguish between preview and management authentication.
issues.suggestedFix: Confirm with Contentstack SDK documentation that `management_token` is the correct key for `live_preview` config. The dependency_contract tool shows it is consumed by the runtime, so this is likely correct — but verify the SDK actually uses it for preview (not just management) operations.

issues.description: The `CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST` is only passed inside the `live_preview` config object but is NOT wired to `Stack.setHost()`. The existing `setHost` call (line 73-75) only uses `CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST`. If the Contentstack SDK does not automatically use `live_preview.host` for preview API requests, preview calls may go to the wrong host.
issues.suggestedFix: Verify that the Contentstack SDK's `live_preview.host` config is sufficient for routing preview requests. If not, add conditional logic to call `Stack.setHost(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST)` when preview is active.

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: The live_preview config object uses `management_token` as the key for CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN. The prescribed minimal fix and the Contentstack SDK documentation specify `preview_token` as the correct key name. Using `management_token` means the SDK will not receive the preview token and live preview will silently not function.
issues.suggestedFix: Change `management_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN` to `preview_token: CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN` in the live_preview config object.

issues.description: Dead code: `livePreview` parameter is added to `createContentTypeQuery` and `createContentTypeEntryQuery`, but NONE of the public functions (getEntry, getSingleEntry, getAllContentTypeEntries, findSingletonEntry) destructure or forward `livePreview` to these factory methods. They all use explicit destructuring without a rest operator (e.g., getEntry destructures `{ contentTypeUid, referenceFieldPath, jsonRtePath, only, lang, includeFields }`), so `livePreview` is silently dropped at every call site. The `livePreview` handling in the factory methods is unreachable dead code — preview context can never flow through to Contentstack queries. This directly contradicts the acceptance criteria that draft content must be visible on the rendered page.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `livePreview?: string` to the public function interfaces (IContentstackGetEntry, IContentstackGetSingleEntry, IContentstackGetSingletonEntry), destructure `livePreview` in each public function, and forward it to `createContentTypeQuery`/`createContentTypeEntryQuery` calls.

issues.description: No test coverage exists for the live_preview feature. Searched the test file for 'preview', 'PREVIEW', 'live_preview', 'livePreview', 'live' — zero matches. Required tests: (1) live_preview block present in options when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST are set, (2) live_preview absent from options when the token is unset, (3) livePreview context flows through a public function (e.g., getEntry) to the Contentstack query's livePreviewQuery method. Without these tests, the feature cannot be verified against the acceptance criteria.
issues.suggestedFix: Add vitest tests covering: options.live_preview presence/absence based on env vars, and an end-to-end test calling getEntry (or getSingleEntry) with a livePreview parameter and asserting that the mock's livePreviewQuery method was called with the correct value.

issues.description: The Contentstack Stack mock does not include a `livePreviewQuery` method. The implementation calls `this.stack.livePreviewQuery(...)` when livePreview is truthy. If the forwarding blocker is fixed and any test passes livePreview through a public function, the test will crash with 'livePreviewQuery is not a function' because the mock object has no such method.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `livePreviewQuery: jest.fn().mockReturnThis()` to the jest.mock Stack factory object.

issues.description: The `livePreview` parameter is added via inline type intersection (`ICreateQueryConfig & { livePreview?: string }`) rather than updating the `ICreateQueryConfig` interface in src/interface/contentstack.ts. This is inconsistent with the codebase pattern and makes the parameter invisible to consumers of the interface. The same applies to `ICreateEntryConfig & { livePreview?: string }`.
issues.suggestedFix: Add `livePreview?: string` directly to the `ICreateQueryConfig` and `ICreateEntryConfig` interfaces in src/interface/contentstack.ts, and remove the inline intersection types.

issues.description: The live_preview config only conditionally includes the preview block when both CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST are set, but does not set the preview host on the Stack via setHost. The existing code calls `Stack.setHost(CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST)` only when CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST is set. The Contentstack SDK live_preview host is set in the options object, but if the preview host differs from the API host, the Stack's primary host may not be updated for preview requests. Verify that the SDK's live_preview.host option is sufficient, or add `Stack.setHost(CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST)` when in preview mode.
issues.suggestedFix: Verify via the Contentstack SDK documentation whether `live_preview.host` in the Stack options is sufficient for preview API calls, or whether `setHost` must also be called with the preview host. If setHost is needed, add a conditional block after the Stack creation.

issues.description: The env var destructuring for CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST follows the existing pattern but these values are not validated or logged when missing, unlike the required env vars (API_KEY, DELIVERY_TOKEN, etc.). While they are optional, a debug log when preview is partially configured (token set but host missing, or vice versa) would help operators diagnose misconfiguration.
issues.suggestedFix: Add an optional logger.warn when only one of CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN or CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is set (not both), indicating incomplete preview configuration.
